parameters.jsCode: const x = $json.body ?? $json; if (!x.user || !x.day || typeof x.anomaly_score !== 'number') throw new Error('Require user, day, anomaly_score'); return [{json:{...x, status:'PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW', automated_action:'none', received_at:new Date().toISOString()}}];
